claim_id.description: Claim ID in format CLM-XXXXXX, where X is a digit

reported_by.description: Full name of person reporting claim

policy_number.description: Policy number in format POL-XXXXXXXXX, where X is a digit

policyholder_name.description: Full legal name on policy, e.g. Will Smith

items.description: List of insured objects involved, if applicable

object_id.description: Unique identifier for insured object. For vehicles, use VIN format (e.g., VIN12345678901234567). For buildings, use PROP-XXXXXX format. For liability, use LIAB-XXXXXX format. For other objects, use OBJ-XXXXXX format, where X is a digit

make_model.description: Make and model for vehicles (use standardtized manufacturer names and models), or building type for property (one word, possible options: house, townhouse, office, shop, bakery)

year.description: Year for vehicles or year built for buildings

location_address.description: Full street address where object is located or originated from, format '1234 Street, Town'

estimated_value.description: Estimated market or insured value of the object itself in USD without currency symbol

location_type.description: Standardized location type where incident occurred.

estimated_damage_amount.description: Estimated damage in USD without currency symbol
